maddeler.e:
أنفصل (form VII)
# أَنْفَصِلُ (ʔanfaṣilu) /ʔan.fa.sˤi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
# أَنْفَصِلَ (ʔanfaṣila) /ʔan.fa.sˤi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
# أَنْفَصِلْ (ʔanfaṣil) /ʔan.fa.sˤil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
